description: Curated research topics for startup and entrepreneurship domain — Business + AI intersection

topics.title: AI Tools and Founder Decision-Making Speed in Early-Stage Startups
topics.question: How do AI tools affect founder decision-making speed and quality in early-stage startups?
topics.novelty_angle: Most prior work examines AI at firm level; founder-level cognitive augmentation is underexplored

topics.title: Machine Learning Predictors of Startup Failure: Early Warning Signals
topics.question: Can machine learning models predict startup failure using early warning signals in financial and operational data?
topics.novelty_angle: High-frequency operational signals (hiring, product updates, web traffic) rarely used as predictors

topics.title: AI-Enabled Business Model Innovation and Competitive Advantage in Startups
topics.question: How does AI-enabled business model innovation create sustainable competitive advantage in technology startups?
topics.novelty_angle: Dynamic capability theory extended to AI-native business model configurations

topics.title: Return on AI Investment in Series A and B Startups
topics.question: What are the ROI implications of AI adoption in Series A and B funded startups and what factors drive value creation?
query_expansions: AI investment return startup venture capital
machine learning ROI early stage company
topics.novelty_angle: Longitudinal VC portfolio-level AI ROI data rarely synthesized

topics.title: AI-Augmented Hiring Practices and Talent Acquisition in High-Growth Startups
topics.question: How do AI-augmented hiring practices affect talent quality and organizational performance in high-growth startups?
topics.novelty_angle: Startup-specific hiring constraints (speed, culture fit) interact with AI tools differently than enterprise

topics.title: Big Data Analytics and Entrepreneurial Resilience in High-Tech Startups
topics.question: How do big data analytics capabilities contribute to entrepreneurial resilience and survival during economic downturns?
topics.novelty_angle: Crisis-period data from COVID-19 and subsequent downturns offers natural experiment

topics.title: AI-Assisted Product-Market Fit Identification in Early-Stage Startups

query_expansions: product market fit AI startup analytics
AI user behavior analysis early stage
topics.novelty_angle: PMF is a foundational startup concept rarely studied with AI-augmented measurement tools

topics.title: Predicting Startup Funding Success Using Natural Language Processing and Financial Signals
topics.question: To what extent can NLP analysis of pitch decks and financial signals predict startup funding success at seed and Series A rounds?
query_expansions: startup funding prediction machine learning NLP
pitch deck analysis natural language processing
